meta.name: Tactics Board
meta.notes: Primary drives the magnets (CTA, counters, filters), gaffer tape and the darkened marker ink (lasso, arrows, rings); accent only tints small details so any palette stays legible on the white board.

issues: Marker tray was position:sticky inside the frame, so in every viewport and full-page shot it floated mid-board over the pinned hero photo and counters (desktop, mobile and catalog)
Category names were chopped letter-by-letter ('FARMACEUTISC H', 'VOEDSELINDUS TRIE') by overflow-wrap:anywhere next to the 'bekijk' note
Marker tool button read as a generic pill with a red blob, not a dry-erase marker; disabled Vergelijk button looked washed-out pink
Marker ghosting texture on the board was nearly invisible (4.5% opacity), so the board read as flat white
Gallery grid left a lone orphan photo in an otherwise empty row with 6 images (stress brand); on mobile the snaps were a single narrow column
Hero headline is clean Teko with no erased-marker history, so it doesn't feel like it was written on a used whiteboard
fixed: Tray is now a static marker ledge at the bottom of the frame in both template.html and catalog.html: no more overlap with hero content
Category meta is a grid: number + name with hyphens:auto/balance, 'bekijk →' moves to its own line, so long Dutch compounds break properly
Marker tool restyled as a real marker (primary end cap, white barrel, grey band, primary cap and tip); disabled compare keeps its colour at reduced saturation
Board ghost strokes raised to 7.5% opacity, and the hero title has faint offset ghost copies like erased marker
Gallery switched to centred flex-wrap (an odd last photo looks pinned on purpose) with a 2-up layout on mobile
